text.autoconfig.crittweaks.title: CritTweaks Configuration
text.autoconfig.crittweaks.option.modEna: Switches the whole mod on or off. When off, everything acts like vanilla.
text.autoconfig.crittweaks.option.forceC: Always shows crit particles, even when your particle setting is on Minimal.
text.autoconfig.crittweaks.option.always: Always have crit particles, even when the hit wasn't actually a critical.
text.autoconfig.crittweaks.option.hideOt: Hides crit particles from other players, so only your own hits show.
text.autoconfig.crittweaks.option.hideIn: Hides the crit particles that pop up on you when you get hit.
text.autoconfig.crittweaks.option.critPa: Lets you multiply how many crit particles show on each hit.
text.autoconfig.crittweaks.option.forceS: Always shows sharpness particles, even when your particle setting is on Minimal.
text.autoconfig.crittweaks.option.always: Always have sharpness particles, even without a sword or any Sharpness.
text.autoconfig.crittweaks.option.hideOt: Hides sharpness particles from other players, so only your own hits show.
text.autoconfig.crittweaks.option.hideIn: Hides the sharpness particles that pop up on you when you get hit.
text.autoconfig.crittweaks.option.sharpn: Lets you multiply how many sharpness particles show on each hit.
